```yaml
name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: Path to the agents directory
        required: false
        default: .continue/agents
    secrets:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:
        required: true

jobs:
  discover_agents:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.discover.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Discover agents
        id: discover
        run: |
          AGENTS=$(find "${{ inputs.agents-path }}" -type f -name '*.md')
          if [ -z "$AGENTS" ]; then
            echo "agents=[]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "agents=$(printf '%s\n' $AGENTS | jq -R . | jq -s .)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  run_agents:
    needs: discover_agents
    if: needs.discover_agents.outputs.agents != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover_agents.outputs.agents) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Continue CLI
        run: npm i -g @continuedev/continue

      - name: Run agent
        id: run_agent
        run: |
          set -e
          continue agent "${{ matrix.agent }}" > output.txt 2>&1
          echo "output=$(cat output.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Create check run
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const output = `${{ steps.run_agent.outputs.output }}`;
            const conclusion = '${{ steps.run_agent.outcome }}' === 'success' ? 'success' : 'failure';
            await github.rest.checks.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              name: `Continue Agent: ${matrix.agent}`,
              head_sha: context.sha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion: conclusion,
              output: {
                title: `Continue Agent: ${matrix.agent}`,
                summary: `Output:\n\`\`\`\n${output}\n\`\`\``,
                text: output
              }
            });

      - name: Write job summary
        run: |
          echo "## Agent ${{ matrix.agent }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Output:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat output.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
